title: Smooth Noether continuity, Gauss propagation and BRST compatibility

smooth_identity.continuity: partial_mu j^mu=0 because Q commutes with D, Q is self-adjoint and the potential is a real function of Q^2 and ||phi||^2
smooth_identity.gauss_propagation: partial_t(div E-j^0)=0 after taking divergence of the spatial Maxwell equation and using continuity
smooth_identity.conditionality: the identity applies to smooth solutions remaining on the common charge core; it is not an existence theorem

brst.rules: sA=dc; sphi=i e c Qphi; sc=0
brst.nilpotency: s^2 A=s^2 c=s^2 phi=0 for odd c on the common core
brst.gauss_covariance: the Abelian Gauss functional is gauge invariant and BRST closed on smooth constrained data
brst.boundary: closed nonlinear KT range, BV-BFV properness and physical Hilbert cohomology are not inferred
